project: QORE-VLM Phase 9F evidence sufficiency and localization

baseline.code_revision: five-ideas-development after the clean Phase 9E gate
baseline.equivalence_test: The frozen baseline arm calls unchanged Generator.generate with the unchanged QORE and Answer Scorer contract; all evidence arms vary only internal diagnostic context text and never selection inputs

core_invariants: Each question is retrieved and selected exactly once before any probe output exists.
The baseline, gold-copy control, and evidence variants use the same model identity, deterministic decoding, evaluator normalization, and question.
Evidence variants are constructed only from selected passages and internal gold lexical matches; no variant text crosses the compact boundary.
Gold-copy control and evidence probes run only after selected-hit baseline EM failure; evidence probes run only after gold-copy EM success.
Probe outputs never feed back into retrieval, selection, generation, or labels.
The existing Generator, selector, evaluator, and stable answer matcher are not modified.
A fresh held-out validation slice is used; no Phase 9E question IDs are reused.
The compact exchange output contains only IDs, flags, variant counts, timings, arm scalars, cohort summaries, and gate results.

interfaces.input_schema: question and diagnostic context or copy-control candidate
interfaces.output_schema: one scalar arm record with attempted, EM, F1, and generation time
invariants: Uses the frozen Generator identity and deterministic decoding.
Does not modify retrieval, selection, evaluator, or labels.
Raw prompt and prediction text remain outside compact exchange output.

interfaces.input_schema: question and deterministic selected-hit evidence variants: sentence/window crossed with plain/highlighted text
interfaces.output_schema: one scalar arm record with attempted, EM, F1, and generation time
invariants: Plain and highlighted variants use the frozen baseline prompt profile.
Highlight markers reveal only the location of an existing lexical match and never add answer text.
Window variants add only the immediately adjacent sentences from the same selected passage.

interfaces.input_schema: compact baseline, copy-control, and 2x2 evidence arm records
interfaces.output_schema: eligible cohort, exclusive 2x2 attribution including both-main-effects and interaction-only classes, paired bootstrap deltas, and a dominant/mixed/insufficient gate
invariants: Primary attribution is restricted to selected-hit baseline EM errors with a successful gold-copy control.
No raw generation text is consumed or emitted by the combiner.
A dominant result is diagnostic only and authorizes no production change.

plugins.insertion_point: after unchanged QORE selection and before metric aggregation
plugins.hypothesis: The unchanged generation arm is the reference for the held-out slice.
plugins.input_schema: question and unchanged selected QORE K=5 passages
plugins.output_schema: baseline EM, F1, and generation time
failure_signatures: model identity or decoding settings drift

plugins.hypothesis: A gold-answer copy control separates output/evaluator inability from evidence-use inability.
plugins.input_schema: question and one internal deterministic gold-answer candidate
plugins.output_schema: conditional copy-control EM, F1, and generation time
plugins.resource_estimate: at most one generation per selected-hit baseline EM failure
failure_signatures: copy control runs outside its condition

plugins.insertion_point: eligible selected-hit baseline error after copy-control success
plugins.hypothesis: The exact answer-bearing sentence is sufficient when irrelevant selected context is the main obstruction.
plugins.input_schema: question and all deterministic exact matched sentence variants
plugins.output_schema: plain matched-sentence EM, F1, and generation time
failure_signatures: sentence text is not derived from selected passages
plain probe changes the prompt profile

plugins.hypothesis: Explicitly locating an existing answer span recovers failures caused by answer localization or extraction.
plugins.input_schema: question and exact matched sentences with internal answer-span markers
plugins.output_schema: highlighted-sentence EM, F1, and generation time
failure_signatures: highlight markers add text not present in selected passages
highlight probe is not paired with plain sentence

plugins.hypothesis: A local neighboring sentence supplies missing evidence needed to interpret a lexical answer mention.
plugins.input_schema: question and exact matched sentence plus its immediately adjacent sentences from each selected passage
plugins.output_schema: plain-window EM, F1, and generation time
failure_signatures: window extends beyond the same selected passage
window probe adds a non-local passage

plugins.hypothesis: Neighbor evidence and explicit localization interact when both are needed.
plugins.input_schema: question and highlighted sentence windows from selected passages
plugins.output_schema: highlighted-window EM, F1, and generation time
failure_signatures: interaction arm is attempted without both main-effect arms
window-highlight text crosses the compact boundary

plugins.insertion_point: after compact arm records are written
plugins.hypothesis: A held-out 2x2 evidence presentation can distinguish local context sufficiency from answer localization.
plugins.output_schema: exclusive attribution, paired bootstrap intervals, and report-only gate
plugins.resource_estimate: scalar aggregation and paired bootstrap only
failure_signatures: small eligible cohort is treated as decisive

composition.merge_rule: Retrieve/select once, run baseline, run copy control only on selected-hit baseline EM failures, run the four paired evidence arms only after copy-control EM success, and aggregate scalar records only.
interaction_ablations: plain sentence versus plain neighboring window
highlighted sentence versus highlighted neighboring window
gold-copy control versus all evidence presentations

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic fixtures prove frozen baseline forwarding is unchanged and custom evidence prompts use only context text.
tests: exact sentence/window extraction and deterministic highlighting

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation[700:750], Wiki-DPR psgs_w100.nq.compressed, nprobe=64, one Top-50 DPR retrieval and one frozen QORE K=5 selection per question
reproducibility.environment: runner records Python executable/version, git revision, config SHA-256, plugin tree hash, resolved generator identity/config hash, retrieval/selection settings, and output paths

limitations: Gold copy and highlighted evidence are oracle diagnostics and cannot support a production claim by themselves.
A local neighboring sentence is only a proxy for evidence sufficiency and does not establish human-judged entailment.
A 50-question held-out slice and one deterministic decoding seed cannot establish broad generalization.
All oracle inputs remain internal and no raw prompt, passage, answer, or prediction is exchanged.
Every gate outcome is report-only and leaves the production selector and generator unchanged.
